purpose: Cross-project coordination only; never merge missions, budgets, data, revenue ledgers or safety boundaries.

authority.controller_role: Registry, shared resource arbitration, cross-repository health and duplicate-run prevention; not a universal mission override.
authority.project_local_authority: Each repository's own constitution, state, queue and acceptance criteria remain authoritative.
authority.identity_note: Email is an identity attribute, not a credential or OAuth permission.

global_invariants: No laptop/local runtime dependency for P10CR swarm.
₹0 new spend by default; no paid fallback, hidden billing, credit purchase or auto-upgrade.
One canonical writer per repository control-plane state at a time.
Every task claim uses lease, expiry and monotonically increasing fencing token.
Cross-project execution is isolated; no project imports another project's tasks or changes its mission.
Agent outputs are untrusted until project-specific evidence and acceptance gates pass.
Never request password, OTP, recovery code, session cookie or private key in chat or commit secrets.
KYC, OAuth consent, legal acceptance, billing activation, payment, publication and irreversible account actions require explicit owner approval.
Respect provider blocks; no account rotation or access-control bypass.

shared_resources.github_actions: Shared finite account-level runner capacity; per-repository concurrency groups are not global locks. Reserve P10CR recovery/CI lane, stagger heavy jobs, and defer work when headroom is unknown or constrained. Exact account concurrency allowance was not verified.
shared_resources.github_api: Concurrent repositories can contend for API/search capacity. Enforce per-project request budgets, caching, jittered backoff and WAITING_FOR_QUOTA. No account rotation or block bypass.
shared_resources.free_model_quotas: Flash Loan semantic pilot uses Ollama loopback on its own ephemeral GitHub runner; no direct shared Cloudflare/OpenRouter/Gemini/Groq quota identified. P10CR model pool remains separate and disabled until its own free-only quota ledger is verified.
shared_resources.secrets: No secrets in registry; use dedicated least-privilege GitHub App after owner approval.
shared_resources.cloud_compute: Never borrow another project's runner, database, model process, artifact or secrets. P10CR fallback order: durable queue/defer; eligible lightweight Cloudflare dispatch; verified zero-cost independent compute; approved free-only model endpoints. Unknown price/terms/quota fails closed.

coordination_policy.lock_service: B4 standalone SQLite lease/fencing prototype only; no deployed cross-host/global lock service. Implement federation runtime only over a verified shared atomic store.
coordination_policy.fencing: Monotonic fencing token per lock scope; stale workers cannot write canonical state.
coordination_policy.state_writer: One authorized publisher per repository control-plane path; other workers submit isolated branches/PRs.
coordination_policy.conflict_resolution: Never last-write-wins for mission state, queues, constitutions, revenue ledgers or evidence registers.
coordination_policy.run_deduplication: Idempotency key + workflow run ID + project/task identity.
coordination_policy.quota_arbitration: Design specified; no deployed shared quota arbiter yet. Next: per-project GitHub Actions/API budgets, fair reservations and WAITING_FOR_QUOTA; no paid fallback.
coordination_policy.thread_identity: Record chat_thread_ref or automation_id where available; missing identity remains unknown.

owner_approval_policy.owner_approves: GitHub App installation, OAuth scopes, Google consent, account setup, KYC, terms, billing changes, public releases and irreversible actions.
owner_approval_policy.automation_may_do_after_grant: Read authorized repos, inspect workflows, create isolated branches, run tests, prepare PRs, dispatch permitted workflows, maintain queues and recover idempotent work.
owner_approval_policy.never_request_in_chat: Google/GitHub password, OTP, backup code, session cookie, private key or unrestricted PAT.
owner_approval_policy.authentication: Provider-hosted OAuth consent and short-lived scoped tokens; revoke through official provider flows.
